title: Day Before an Event
summary: Of the sessions whose NEXT trading session is an event day in the named calendar, how often the session closed above its open. 'Next' is trading-calendar aware: a Thursday counts as the day before a Monday event when Friday is a holiday: not naive date arithmetic. The default calendar is OPEX because it ships with the engine; point the parameter at FOMC, CPI, NFP, or any calendar file you add, and the preset reports zero matching sessions until that file is present.

params.name: event
params.doc: Event calendar name as listed in the events data (e.g. OPEX, FOMC, CPI, NFP).

deltas: one parameterized preset covers the entire pre-event family
holiday-aware adjacency instead of calendar-day arithmetic
user-supplied event files (earnings, expiries, journal tags) work identically
